count_semantics: Subsets overlap the full suite; never add them to the total.

startup.scope: Actual disposable Uvicorn factories and health; startup failure refuses readiness.

configuration.scope: Existing settings refuse LIVE/no-simulation/autonomous activation and production in-memory DB.

data.scope: Offline adapters verified; real entitlement/alignment/liquidity/as-of gaps remain.

agents.scope: Bounded non-live schema-grounded interpretation; cannot authorize funds.

opportunity.scope: Production blocked by Trust and incomplete real input/host assembly.

routing.scope: Production-capable shared architecture, deterministic offline tests; provider verification partial.

risk.scope: Hard controls verified; complete current real funding/inventory inputs unavailable.

quote.scope: Exact offline provider contracts and expiry; no new real route entitlement verification.

simulation.scope: Synthetic and failure guards pass; actual SWAP/RFQ execution equivalence unverified.

wallet.scope: Actual authenticated runtime/session/quotas unverified; unavailable refuses execution.

execution.scope: DRY_RUN only; no executable public endpoint, complete immutable settlement required.

positions.scope: Non-live durable lifecycle, partial/unknown ownership, leased monitor, conservative exit and recovery.

portfolio.scope: Non-live planning/idempotency verified; complete real inputs and autonomous execution blocked.

scorecard.scope: Original decisions/outcomes preserved; unsupported truth/composite/realized-cost metrics withheld.

audit.scope: Atomic typed references, immutable originals, safe summaries and point-in-time filtering.

agent_api_mcp.scope: Seven local-only tools and actual SDK stdio; remote authorization not implemented.

frontend.scope: Built desktop/mobile/tablet journeys, safe errors/labels and backend-authoritative values.

security.scope: Offline guards/secret artifact scan; dependency consistency, not a new vulnerability certification.

concurrency.scope: Exact 21-case tested scope; no global request serialization. Not multi-host deployment proof.

restart.scope: Transaction/coroutine interruption, fresh stores/processes; not an OS power-loss certification.

replay.scope: Deterministic/leak-free controls pass; 48 real candidates all unscorable, no predictive validity claim.

performance.scope: Required local paths and 10/25/50/100 universes measured; no provider latency/SLA certification.

deployment_readiness.scope: Non-live development RC only; no deployment or Phase 17/18 work.

failure_injection: 401/403/404/429/500/503/timeouts/malformed/schema drift/missing/stale/unavailable sources, quote expiry, simulation failure, contradictory settlements covered by full suites.
interruption_model: SystemExit within transaction/preparation; coroutine cancellation; close/reopen SQLite stores; existing actual fresh-process portfolio recovery; actual stdio subprocess. No real external transaction and no power-loss test.
ephemeral_state: DEMO/test in-memory runtime and paper ledgers are intentionally session-only; durability applies to existing disk journals. No production synthetic seeding.
unresolved_receipts: Pending/lost/cancelled claims remain reconciliation-required; no TTL reset/resubmission. Pre-submission preparation retains inert journal identity and cannot invent confirmation.
